zh-CN/about:
萌趣MOEQY 是一个非商业性质的爱好者网站，网站致力于练习技术以及个人作品分享。我希望萌趣能够成为我的阶梯，一步步的记录我的成长。同时萌趣难免会有各种问题以及瑕疵，也欢迎各位提出宝贵的建议与交流。

“在回忆的白纸上，绘上梦想的碎片” 作为 萌趣MOEQY 的理念。其源自于动漫《白箱》主题曲《COLORFUL BOX》，其中 “真っ白な想いに，夢のかけらを” 歌词的中文翻译。《白箱》这部作品是一个特别励志的作品，虽然剧中的人们大多数与我的生活没有多少关系，但是他们为我们展示的是一群创作者突破自我的表现。“所谓的励志，并非美化现实，也不是神化追梦的人。” 而世界上只有一种英雄主义，那就是认清现实之后仍然热爱生活。

萌趣MOEQY，是一个爱好 ACGN 的温馨小窝。

zh-CN/privacy:
本站重视您的隐私和个人信息保护。当您浏览本站时，为了提高网站阅读体验，本站可能会收集和使用您的相关信息。
通过本《隐私协议》会向您说明在 moeqy.com 以及其系列网站时，如何收集、使用、保存、共享和转让这些信息。
访问 moeqy.com 系列网站（以下简称为“本站”、“MOEQY”、“我们”）即代表您已认可本《隐私协议》（以下简称为“本协议”、“协议”、“隐私协议”）。

在阅读《隐私协议》时，你可以通过查看斜体标注来更好地理解本隐私协议。

本站将收集以下信息：

1.访问

当您访问站点时，本站会收集您的运营商 IP 信息至 LeanCloud 用于用户访问数据统计。
LeanCloud 的隐私协议详见：https://leancloud.app/privacy/。

为提升网站性能与安全性，本站使用 Cloudflare 作为内容分发网络（CDN）及 DNS 解析服务。在您访问本站时，Cloudflare 可能会收集包括但不限于您的 IP 地址、访问请求信息、浏览器类型等技术数据，用于提供防护、缓存加速与流量分析服务。
Cloudflare 的隐私政策详见：https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/。

2.评论

访客留下评论时，本站会收集评论表单所显示的数据，和访客的IP地址及浏览器的user agent字符串来帮助检查垃圾评论以及在评论显示您所使用的浏览器与系统。如果您在评论时输入了昵称(必填)、邮箱(必填)、个人网站地址(选填)，本站会将您的填写的个人信息保存至 LeanCloud 数据库。

由您的电子邮件地址所生成的匿名化字符串（又称为哈希）可能会被提供给Gravatar服务确认您是否有使用该服务。Gravatar服务的隐私协议详见：https://automattic.com/privacy/。在您的评论获批准后，您的资料图片将在您的评论旁公开展示。

如果您在本站留下的评论受到了回复，系统会自动生成一封提示邮件发送到您的邮箱。

3.在线留言

在线留言使用了 Tidio Chat 插件进行搭建。当您在使用其服务时会识别您的运营商 IP 信息，以识别不同用户留言和在线情况。
当您在在线留言时填入了您的个人信息后（昵称和电子邮箱），将会保存至 Tidio 的用户详情界面。
Tidio 的隐私协议详见：https://www.tidio.com/privacy-policy/。

4.LocalStorage & Cookies

本站会使用 LocalStorage（本地存储）来保存您的评论用户信息、深夜模式切换记录等，优化网站体验。

本站自身不主动使用任何 Cookies，但由于本站使用了 Cloudflare CDN 和网络防护服务，Cloudflare 可能会设置少量与安全相关的 Cookies（如识别恶意访问、通过验证码验证等）。这些 Cookies 仅用于保障访问安全，不用于用户追踪或广告目的。如果您的浏览器处于安全环境下，您可以放心浏览网页无需担心第三方 Cookie 介入收集信息推广。

LocalStorage 会将您在本站设置的信息保存在您的浏览器本地，而 Cookies 是由服务器生成以保存您的用户信息。
MOEQY 没有使用后端，所有信息保存都使用的是本地存储。

5.来自其他网站的嵌入内容

本站可能会包含嵌入的内容（如视频、图片、文章等）。来自其他站点的嵌入内容的行为和您直接访问这些其他站点没有区别。
这些站点可能会收集关于您的数据、使用 Cookies、嵌入额外的第三方跟踪程序及监视您与这些嵌入内容的交互，包括在您有这些站点的账户并登录了这些站点时，跟踪您与嵌入内容的交互。

6.共享与转让

本站所收集的数据信息仅用于网站数据分析，不会与任何公司、组织和个人共享您的个人信息，不会将您的个人信息转让给任何公司、组织和个人。

您对信息所持有的必要权利：

若您在本站留下了需要隐藏的信息，您可以通过评论、联系站长邮箱等形式联系站长删除。

关于本隐私协议：

本隐私协议如若有更新，将会第一时间公布于 MOEQY 的主页。您可以点击主页公告中的提示链接查看更新内容。

本隐私协议是参照众多博客隐私协议编写，并适当修改为适合本站的协议。

en/about:
MOEQY is a non-commercial enthusiast website dedicated to practicing and sharing personal works. I hope that MOEQY can become my ladder and record my growth step by step. At the same time, MOEQY will inevitably have various problems and flaws. We also welcome your valuable suggestions and exchanges.

"On the paper of memories, draw fragments of dreams" is the concept of MOEQY. It comes from the translation of the lyrics of the theme music "COLORFUL BOX", from the anime "Shirobako": "真っ白な思いに, 梦のかけらを". "Shirobako" is a particularly inspirational work. Although most of the people in the play have little to do with my life, what they show us is the performance of a group of creators who break through themselves. "The so-called inspiration is not to beautify reality, nor to deify people who pursue dreams." There is only one kind of heroism in the world, and that is to still love life after recognizing reality.

MOEQY is a cozy little home for ACGN lovers.

en/privacy:
The translation is only for users to better understand our privacy policy. To avoid translation mistakes, please refer to Simplified Chinese (简体中文) for the privacy policy.

We attach great importance to your privacy and personal information protection. When you browse this site, we may collect and use your relevant information to improve the browsing experience.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, share, and transfer such information when you visit moeqy.com and its affiliated websites.
By accessing moeqy.com and its series of websites (hereinafter referred to as "the Site", "MOEQY", "we"), you acknowledge and accept this Privacy Policy (hereinafter referred to as "the Policy", "this Agreement", "Privacy Policy").

When reading the "Privacy Policy", you can better understand it by referring to the italicized annotations.

The Site will collect the following information:

1. Access

When you access the Site, we collect your carrier IP information to LeanCloud for user visit data analysis.
LeanCloud's privacy policy: https://leancloud.app/privacy/。

To improve site performance and ensure security, this Site uses Cloudflare for content delivery (CDN) and DNS resolution. When you access the Site, Cloudflare may collect technical information such as your IP address, browser details, and request data for purposes such as content caching, security protection, and traffic analytics.
Cloudflare's Privacy Policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/。

2. Comments

When visitors leave comments, the Site collects the data shown in the comment form, as well as the visitor's IP address and browser user agent string to help detect spam. If you enter a nickname (required), email address (required), and personal website URL (optional) when commenting, the information will be saved in the LeanCloud database.

An anonymized string (also known as a hash) generated from your email address may be provided to the Gravatar service to check if you use it. Gravatar's privacy policy: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After your comment is approved, your profile image will be publicly displayed next to your comment.

If your comment is replied to, the system will automatically send a notification email to your inbox.

3. Online Message

The online message function uses the Tidio Chat plugin. When using the service, your carrier IP address is used to distinguish different users and online statuses.
If you enter your personal information (nickname and email address) in the chat, it will be stored in Tidio's user details panel.
Tidio's privacy policy: https://www.tidio.com/privacy-policy/。

4. LocalStorage & Cookies

The Site uses LocalStorage to save your comment user information, dark mode switch settings, etc., to optimize user experience.

This site does not actively use any cookies. However, as the site utilizes Cloudflare CDN and security protection services, Cloudflare may set a small number of security-related cookies (such as those used to identify malicious visits or verify CAPTCHA challenges). These cookies are used solely for security purposes and are not intended for tracking or advertising. If your browser operates in a secure environment, you can browse the site with confidence, without worrying about third-party cookies collecting data for promotional use.

LocalStorage saves your settings locally in your browser, while Cookies are generated by servers to store user information.
MOEQY does not use a backend; all data is stored via local storage.

5. Embedded Content from Other Sites

This Site may include embedded content (such as videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other sites behaves exactly the same as if you visited the external site directly.
These sites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content — including tracking your interaction if you have an account and are logged in to that site.

6. Sharing and Transfer

The data collected by the Site is used only for website data analysis. We do not share your personal information with any company, organization, or individual, nor transfer it to any third party.

Your Rights Regarding Information:

If you have submitted information on the Site that needs to be hidden, you can contact the site owner via comment or email to request removal.

About This Privacy Policy:

If this privacy policy is updated, it will be promptly published on the MOEQY homepage. You can click the notice link on the homepage to view the updated content.

This Privacy Policy is adapted from various blog privacy policies and modified to fit the practices of this Site.
If you find any part inappropriate, please contact us through the following channels for discussion or revision:

Email
mail#moeqy.com
(Please replace # with @)

MOEQY
